content.text: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery, in short BAMS, is an undergraduate program with a duration of 5.5 years, including an on-field internship. This course moulds the students to get a hands-on experience in Ayurveda. There are a total of 32 BAMS colleges in Gujarat. Among them, 8 are government colleges and 24 are private ones. In this article, we will discuss in detail the eligibility, admission procedure, top colleges, and fee structure for BAMS admission in Gujarat.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission in Gujarat 2025 Overview

content.text: All of the aspirants who want to pursue the BAMS undergrad degree must appear for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) and qualify it. NEET-UG qualified candidates can only attend the AYUSH state counselling. The Gujarat Ayush Counselling session is conducted by the Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Courses (ACPUGMEC). All over the country, the procedure for BAMS admission is the same. There are 2392 total BAMS seats in Gujarat. All these seats are distributed in 32 private and government colleges equally. The state council regulates the whole BAMS admission in Gujarat. While the NEET is mandatory for BAMS admission, candidates also have to complete their 12th with PCB (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) subjects.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Gujarat

content.text: The whole procedure of BAMS admission in Gujarat is given below in a step-by-step guide to help students navigate smoothly through the admission process.
Step 1: Appear and score above the cut-off marks in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test. The Gujarat Ayurved University sets the cut-off each year.
Step 2: Fill out the application form to apply for the AYUSH state counselling session conducted by the ACPUGMEC .
Step 3: The whole counselling process occurs online through their centralised portal. Register yourself on it with all the necessary documents and generate your login credentials.
Step 4: During the counselling session, the next step is to provide your college preferences. Select colleges according to your preference in the choice filling round.

Step 5: Based on the candidate’s NEET score and state rank, the counselling authority will allot seats. The allotment list is published, depending on your preferences and seat availability in the college.
Step 6: Once your seat is allotted, report to your college with all the documents, both in originals and photocopies, and complete the document verification.
Step 7: Lastly, to finalise your candidature, pay the prescribed admission fees to confirm your admission to the college.

Remember, there happens to be 4 rounds of counselling for BAMS admission in Gujarat – Round 1, Round 2, the Mop-Up Round, and the Stray Vacancy Round. If your seat is not allotted in a round, you can participate in the further rounds.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Gujarat

content.text: The aspirants must consider the following set of eligibility criteria before taking BAMS admission in Gujarat. The BAMS eligibility in Gujarat includes a qualifying entrance exam.
Academic Qualification

items: Candidates must pass their 12th board exam with subjects Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB subjects).
Candidates need to secure a 50% aggregate in their board exam in PCB subjects. (For SC/ST candidates, the aggregate is 40%)

content.text: Entrance Exam

items: Candidates must qualify NEET UG 2025 exam with a high percentile, which is higher than the cut-off mark set by the Gujarat Ayurved University.

content.text: Age Limit

items: The willing students need to be over 17 years of age on 31st December, 2025.

sections.heading: Documents Required for Admission

content.text: The set of documents required for BAMS admission in Gujarat is pre-prescribed by the ACPUGMEC. Remember to carry them both in originals and photocopies. Failing to produce any single one of them at the time of document verification may result in the cancellation of the candidature. The list is given below.

items: Admit card of NEET UG
Result / Rank Letter of NEET UG
Allotment Letter
12th Mark Statement
School Leaving / Transfer Certificate / Migration
Proof of Date of Birth (10th Passing Certificate / Birth Certificate)
Proof of Identity (Self-Attested Photocopy of Aadhar Card / Voter Card / PAN Card / Driving License)
Proof of Address (Self-Attested Photocopy of Domicile Certificate / Passport of the Candidate)
Physical / Medical Fitness Certificate
Passport size Photographs (6 copies)
Self-Attested Photocopy of Caste Certificate /Non-Creamy Layer/ Disability Certificate (if applicable)

sections.heading: BAMS Fees in Gujarat

content.text: BAMS fees in Gujarat are set by the college in which you are taking admission. As the Government of India and the Ministry of AYUSH jointly agreed to give the colleges independence to set their own admission fees for BAMS.

Also, the BAMS fees in Gujarat are different in government and private colleges. While the government ones take lower fees, the private ones promise flourishing infrastructure and well-trained faculty with higher fees. For a more detailed fee structure, visit the official website of the college.

sections.heading: BAMS Opportunities in Gujarat

content.text: BAMS graduates have diverse career options. The passouts of the previous years have secured BAMS jobs in Gujarat in several posts like Medical Officer, Ayurvedic Doctor, Research and Academics, Pharmaceutical Industrials, etc. Many hospitals and nursing homes are on the lookout for BAMS graduates. The demand for Ayurveda is increasing day by day, and with it, the job opportunities are skyrocketing in India. The average BAMS salary in Gujarat is INR 4 – 6 Lakhs annually. But the BAMS doctor salary in Gujarat is more. BAMS graduates can also pursue further studies in different specialisations of Ayurveda.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: There are 3024 BAMS vacancy in Gujarat – 429 government seats and 2595 private seats. All these seats are also divided into state quota and all-India quota. Although NEET is mandatory for BAMS admission in Gujarat, securing a seat in a government college solely depends on the decision of the counselling authority (ACPUGMEC). For taking admission, candidates must attend the four-round BAMS counselling in Gujarat.
